series: Walkthrough for the bank Short debt-minimums-119-months.json, built Oct 7, 2026 for CMO review
hook: Minimums only on five debts: 119 months to pay off
hook_say: This video shows how long five debts take to pay off on minimum payments only, and what one fixed monthly amount on the Avalanche plan changes.

rows.label: What you owe today
rows.why: The tracker's example has five debts: a Visa card, a store card, a car loan, a student loan and a personal loan. About $38,155 is owed today.

rows.label: Sum of your minimums
rows.why: Each debt has a minimum payment. Together they come to $831 a month, the least you can pay and stay current.

rows.label: Minimums only: debt-free in
rows.why: Pay only the minimums, with nothing rolled over when a debt clears, and the last one, the student loan, is not paid off for 119 months.

rows.label: Interest, minimums only (est.)
rows.why: Over that time, the estimated interest still to pay is $11,093. That is the price of the slow plan.

rows.label: Monthly amount for all debts
rows.why: Now set one amount for all debts: $1,100 a month. That covers every minimum plus $269 extra, and when a debt is paid off, its payment rolls onto the next one.

rows.label: Avalanche: debt-free in
rows.why: Avalanche sends the extra to the highest rate first: the store card at 26.99%, then the Visa at 24.99%. Debt-free in 40 months.

fix.label: Interest saved vs minimums only (est.)
fix.why: Estimated interest on the Avalanche plan is $4,965, about $6,127 less than paying minimums only. Same debts, same rates.

sources_build: Built from the repo engine with python3 engines/debt-payoff-tracker/build_xlsx.py and recalculated in LibreOffice headless (tools/render_xlsx.py, 0 error values) on Oct 7, 2026. The tracker counts from TODAY(); month counts hold for any October 2026 date; owed-today shifts by cents a day.. New numbers in the walkthrough lines were read the same way from a fresh build recalculated Oct 7, 2026.

Five example debts on minimum payments only take 119 months, with about $11,093 of estimated interest. One fixed $1,100 a month on the Avalanche plan clears them in 40 months, about $6,127 less interest. Example numbers from the Debt Payoff Tracker; estimates for planning only.
